subject.title: feat: expose message topics in the web app

question: Should ClickClack adopt topic assignment and server-paginated topic filtering as a supported core web and SDK capability now?
rationale: The existing topic model makes this technically plausible, but this PR expands it into a public web workflow and message-list contract across 38 files; that product scope needs an explicit maintainer choice before an external contribution lands.

options.title: Sponsor the topic workflow
options.body: Accept this as the intended core workflow after the sqlc repair and real browser proof are supplied.

options.title: Defer the web and SDK expansion
options.body: Keep the existing API-only topic model until maintainers define a narrower or different user-facing topic workflow.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the topic workflow
recommendation.body: Accept this as the intended core workflow after the sqlc repair and real browser proof are supplied.
